CREDIT DECISION SUMMARY
========================================
Model Assessment: LOW RISK — unlikely to default
Estimated Default Probability: 40.3%
Decision Threshold: 50%

IMPORTANT: This is a statistical model score, not a guarantee. The model estimates a 40.3% probability of serious delinquency within two years based on the provided credit data. Actual outcomes depend on many factors not captured by this model.

KEY FACTORS DRIVING THIS ASSESSMENT
========================================

1. APPLICANT AGE
   Observed value : 34
   Risk impact    : This factor increases the estimated default risk (+0.358).
   Interpretation : At 34 years old, the applicant's age is associated with shorter credit history.

2. REVOLVING CREDIT UTILIZATION (THE SHARE OF AVAILABLE CREDIT IN USE)
   Observed value : 43.1%
   Risk impact    : This factor increases the estimated default risk (+0.231).
   Interpretation : A utilization of 43.1% means the applicant is using a significant portion of available revolving credit. High utilization is one of the strongest predictors of default risk.

3. NUMBER OF TIMES 30-59 DAYS PAST DUE (RECENT MILD DELINQUENCIES)
   Observed value : 0
   Risk impact    : This factor decreases the estimated default risk (-0.152).
   Interpretation : No recorded 30-59-day late payments, which is a positive signal.
